sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND c.status = 'approved' AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
explanation: Approved Q3 applications joined to their ask_applicant documents.
